text:
Rae: Quick heads-up: planning to ship compact-embed change for embeddings-service tomorrow 2026-04-12 04:00 UTC. Draft RN: https://internal/redwood/rn/compact-embed-2026-04-12.md. Canary -> us-central -> eu. Need pin owner + rollback owner and someone to post internal announce.

Diego: I can pin and own rollout. Target image: embed-compact:v3.0.0-int. I'll stage at 03:30 UTC.

Marta: Ops recommends a 12m canary in us-central, then 15m in eu-west. Set automatic rollout to stop if error_rate > 1.8% or latency p95 increases > 25%. I'll prepare fallback to embed-stable:v2.9.8.

Ethan: Oncall for the window. Please paste the deploy command so I can add smoke checks to the pipeline. Also request that the RN includes a short impact line for customers.

DeployBot: deploybot: queued embeddings-service image embed-compact:v3.0.0-int -> staging. Use:
```
/deploy embeddings-service --image=embed-compact:v3.0.0-int --env=prod --canary=12m --pin=false
```

Rae: RN edits before blast: include rollback steps, contact list (oncall + eng-sre), token/latency delta (+0.05 tokens per embed, p95 ~ +18ms). Also mark embargo until 4:30 UTC for external comms.

Diego: Rolling snippet and rollout plan added to RN. Rollback cmd:
```
# rollback to last stable
/deploy embeddings-service --image=embed-stable:v2.9.8 --env=prod --force --reason="rollback: perf or errors"
```

Marta: Ops triggers: if canary error_rate >= 1.8% for 5m OR p95 > baseline*1.25 -> immediate rollback. I'll write ops-runbooks/embeds-canary.md and link it.

Ethan: Smoke tests: GET /health -> 200; POST /v1/embed small vector test and assert tokens <= 2 and latency < 200ms. I'll wire into preflight.

Rae: Who will post internals? I'd like the short blurb posted to #eng and #support 10 minutes after full rollout.

Marta: I'll post to #eng (include runbook link and rollback snippet).

Ethan: I'll post to #support with customer-facing short note and the impact sentence.

DeployBot: deploy started at 1765008300 (status: canary running) — https://deployboard/redwood/1765008300

Ethan: First 3m: health checks pass, smoke embed latency ~120ms, tokens unchanged.

Marta: Error rate at 0.3% during canary. p95 up +10ms. All clear so far.

Diego: Expanding to eu-west at 04:15 UTC. If that passes, I'll pin to 80% and then 100% after a 10m stable window.

DeployBot: expanded canary to eu-west at 1765008460 (status: canary expanded).

Ethan: eu-west: one host returned 502 on health, autoscaler restarted it, recovered. No sustained 5xx.

Marta: Monitoring cluster-level metrics; transient spike noted but within thresholds. Keep watch for 5m sustained errors.

Diego: Pinning to production route at 80% now.

DeployBot: partial pin applied at 1765008560 (pin=80%).

Rae: Uploading final internal blurb to docs/announce-drafts/compact-embed-internal.txt. Link added to RN.

Ethan: Posting support note now with impact: "minor token cost + small p95 increase; no functional changes."

Marta: Final 10m watch window started. p95 stable, error rate 0.5%. Ops runbook linked and owners assigned.

DeployBot: rollout completed at 1765008700 (status: success, rollout 100%). Summary: us-central 12m -> eu-west 15m -> staged expansion -> 100% complete.

Rae: Great work. Reminder: hold external blast until 04:30 UTC embargo lift and update customer-facing RN with the cost/rollback lines.

Diego: Will open a small PR to add the cost bullet and rollback excerpt.

Ethan: Archiving canary logs and posting snapshot to this thread.

Marta: Closing ops checklist. If anything regresses, use the rollback command and ping #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:

Rae: Thanks team — closing thread and will follow up on external comms at embargo lift.
